programs.title: Return to Paradise 2
programs.desc: Detective Mackenzie "Mack" Clarke (Anna Samson), instead of returning to her quiet life in Britain, remains in Dolphin Cove, where she tries to avoid her ex-fiance, who is planning another wedding.She focuses on what she does best - solving complex crime puzzles.Together with his trusted team, Mack engages in subsequent investigations, reaching, among others, the world of literature, modern research laboratories and rock concerts.He handles each case with his characteristic enthusiasm and sense of humor.However, the most difficult task for her turns out to be finding her own place in Dolphin Cove.

actor: Senior Sergeant Philomena Strong - Catherine McClements
Constable Felix Wilkinson - Aaron L. McGrath

programs.title: Call the Midwife 14
programs.desc: The fourteenth season of the series inspired by the memories of Jennifer Worth.1970. Nuns and midwives from Nonnatus House continue to support the inhabitants of the poor East End, where terrible living conditions and infectious diseases take their toll.Growing protests on the Isle of Dogs further complicate their daily work.The team faces exceptionally difficult challenges: a mysterious teenage pregnancy, a case of bipolar disorder, a gonorrhea infection and a dramatic childbirth, which put their knowledge and empathy to the test.
